<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="es">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0">
<title>Adriana María & William Enrique 💍</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,400;0,700;1,400;1,700&family=Raleway:wght@200;300;400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<script src="https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/9.22.0/firebase-app-compat.js"></script>
<script src="https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/9.22.0/firebase-firestore-compat.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/qrcodejs/1.0.0/qrcode.min.js"></script>
<style>
/* ============================================================
   VARIABLES & RESET
============================================================ */
:root {
  --navy:        #0D1B2A;
  --navy-mid:    #162236;
  --navy-light:  #1E3050;
  --navy-soft:   #243B55;
  --pearl:       #F5F0E8;
  --pearl-warm:  #EDE8DC;
  --pearl-bright:#FDFBF7;
  --pearl-mid:   #D6CFBF;
  --silver:      #C8D4DC;
  --silver-glow: #E0EAF0;
  --accent:      #8BB8D4;
  --accent-glow: rgba(139,184,212,0.35);
  --gold-pearl:  #C9B99A;
  --white:       #FFFFFF;

  --font-display: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif;
  --font-body:    'Raleway', sans-serif;
}

*,*::before,*::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin:0; padding:0; }
html { scroll-behavior: smooth; font-size:16px; }

body {
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  background: var(--navy);
  color: var(--pearl);
  min-height: 100vh;
  overflow-x: hidden;
}

/* ============================================================
   PARTICLES CANVAS
============================================================ */
#particles-canvas {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 0;
  opacity: 0.5;
}

/* ============================================================
   HERO
============================================================ */
#page-hero {
  position: relative;
  min-height: 100vh;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-align: center;
}

.hero-bg {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background:
    linear-gradient(175deg, rgba(13,27,42,0.80) 0%, rgba(13,27,42,0.65) 40%, rgba(13,27,42,0.88) 100%),
    linear-gradient(135deg, #0D1B2A 0%, #162236 40%, #1E3050 70%, #243B55 100%);
  background-size: cover, cover;
  background-position: center, center;
  z-index: 1;
  transition: opacity 0.8s;
}

/* When user uploads a photo it replaces the gradient */
.hero-bg.has-photo {
  background-blend-mode: multiply;
}

.hero-bg-img {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100%; height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  z-index: 0;
  filter: saturate(0.6) brightness(0.38);
}

.hero-shimmer {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 2;
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 25% 30%, rgba(139,184,212,0.12) 0%, transparent 55%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 75% 70%, rgba(201,185,154,0.08) 0%, transparent 50%);
  pointer-events: none;
  animation: shimmerPulse 8s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
}

@keyframes shimmerPulse {
  from { opacity: 0.6; }
  to   { opacity: 1; }
}

.hero-content {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 3;
  padding: 2rem 1.5rem;
  max-width: 800px;
  width: 100%;
}

.hero-eyebrow {
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.45em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--silver);
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
  opacity: 0;
  animation: riseIn 1s ease 0.4s forwards;
}

.hero-names {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-style: italic;
  font-weight: 400;
  font-size: clamp(2.6rem, 7vw, 5.5rem);
  color: var(--pearl-bright);
  line-height: 1.1;
  text-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.9), 0 4px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.7), 0 0 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
  opacity: 0;
  animation: riseIn 1.1s ease 0.7s forwards;
}

.hero-amp {
  display: block;
  font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 4vw, 2.8rem);
  color: #0D1B2A;
  font-style: normal;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: 0.5em;
  margin: 0.4rem 0;
  opacity: 0;
  animation: riseIn 1s ease 1s forwards;
}

.hero-date-line {
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.3em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: #0D1B2A;
  text-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
  margin-top: 1.8rem;
  opacity: 0;
  animation: riseIn 1s ease 1.2s forwards;
}

/* Decorative rule */
.deco-line {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  justify-content: center;
  margin: 1.2rem auto;
  opacity: 0;
  animation: riseIn 1s ease 1.4s forwards;
}

.deco-line::before,
.deco-line::after {
  content: '';
  flex: 1;
  max-width: 120px;
  height: 1px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(13,27,42,0.7), transparent);
}

.deco-diamond {
  width: 7px; height: 7px;
  background: #0D1B2A;
  transform: rotate(45deg);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

/* ============================================================
   COUNTDOWN
============================================================ */
.countdown-block {
  margin: 1.5rem auto 0;
  opacity: 0;
  animation: riseIn 1s ease 1.6s forwards;
}

.countdown-label {
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.3em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: #0D1B2A;
  text-shadow: none;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
  font-style: normal;
}

.countdown-units {
  display: flex;
  gap: 1rem;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.cd-unit {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
}

.cd-num {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 3.6rem);
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #0D1B2A;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: #0D1B2A;
  background: none;
  line-height: 1;
  min-width: 3ch;
  text-align: center;
  position: relative;
}

.cd-num::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  bottom: -4px; left: 0; right: 0;
  height: 1px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #0D1B2A, transparent);
}

.cd-lbl {
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.18em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: #0D1B2A;
  margin-top: 4px;
}

.cd-sep {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 2rem;
  color: #0D1B2A;
  font-weight: 700;
  opacity: 0.8;
  align-self: flex-start;
  margin-top: 0.3rem;
}

/* ============================================================
   HERO BUTTONS
============================================================ */
.hero-cta {
  margin-top: 2.5rem;
  opacity: 0;
  animation: riseIn 1s ease 1.9s forwards;
}

.hero-cta p {
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 300;
  letter-spacing: 0.2em;
  color: #7ECBE6;
  margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.moment-btns {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

/* Glow buttons */
.btn-moment {
  position: relative;
  padding: 0.8rem 1.8rem;
  background: rgba(18,36,60,0.55);
  border: 1px solid rgba(126,203,230,0.5);
  border-radius: 50px !important;
  color: var(--pearl);
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: 0.2em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  cursor: pointer;
  border-radius: 50px;
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
  backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
}

.btn-moment::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(139,184,212,0.08), rgba(201,185,154,0.05));
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.3s;
}

.btn-moment::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 0; left: -100%; border-radius: 50px;
  width: 100%; height: 1.5px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--accent), var(--silver), transparent);
  transition: left 0.5s ease;
}

.btn-moment:hover { border-color: #7ECBE6; color: #fff; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(126,203,230,0.35), 0 0 40px rgba(126,203,230,0.15); }
.btn-moment:hover::before { opacity: 1; }
.btn-moment:hover::after { left: 100%; }

/* Animated glow pulse */
.btn-moment.pulse {
  animation: glowPulse 3s ease-in-out infinite;
}

@keyframes glowPulse {
  0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 transparent; }
  50% { box-shadow: 0 0 18px 3px rgba(139,184,212,0.25), 0 0 30px 6px rgba(139,184,212,0.1); }
}

/* ============================================================
   PHOTO UPLOAD (hero background)
============================================================ */
.hero-photo-upload {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 1.5rem;
  right: 1.5rem;
  z-index: 4;
  opacity: 0;
  animation: riseIn 1s ease 2.2s forwards;
}

.btn-upload-bg {
  background: rgba(13,27,42,0.6);
  border: 1px solid rgba(200,212,220,0.25);
  color: var(--pearl-mid);
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 10px;
  letter-spacing: 0.15em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  border-radius: 50px;
  transition: all 0.2s;
}

.btn-upload-bg:hover { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--pearl); }

/* ============================================================
   NAV
============================================================ */
#main-nav {
  display: none;
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 200;
  background: rgba(13,27,42,0.92);
  backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(200,212,220,0.1);
  padding: 0 1.5rem;
  height: 52px;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
}

.nav-brand {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-style: italic;
  font-size: 16px;
  color: var(--pearl);
  font-weight: 400;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.nav-links {
  display: flex;
  list-style: none;
  gap: 0;
}

.nav-links a {
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 400;
  letter-spacing: 0.15em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: rgba(200,212,220,0.55);
  text-decoration: none;
  padding: 0 0.9rem;
  height: 52px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: color 0.2s;
  position: relative;
}

.nav-links a::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 0; left: 0.9rem; right: 0.9rem;
  height: 1.5px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #7ECBE6, transparent);
  transform: scaleX(0);
  transition: transform 0.2s;
}

.nav-links a:hover, .nav-links a.active { color: #7ECBE6; text-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(126,203,230,0.6); }
.nav-links a:hover::after, .nav-links a.active::after { transform: scaleX(1); }

/* ============================================================
   MOMENT BANNERS
============================================================ */
.moment-banner {
  position: relative;
  padding: 3.5rem 1.5rem 2.5rem;
  text-align: center;
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* Ceremonia banner */
.banner-ceremonia {
  background: linear-gradient(160deg, #0D1B2A 0%, #162236 35%, #1a2d47 65%, #243B55 100%);
}
.banner-recepcion {
  background: linear-gradient(160deg, #0f2030 0%, #16283d 35%, #1c3350 65%, #1E3050 100%);
}
.banner-horaloca {
  background: linear-gradient(160deg, #0a1520 0%, #111e30 40%, #162236 70%, #0D1B2A 100%);
}

.banner-inner-glow {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.banner-ceremonia .banner-inner-glow {
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 0%, rgba(139,184,212,0.15) 0%, transparent 60%);
}
.banner-recepcion .banner-inner-glow {
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 0%, rgba(201,185,154,0.12) 0%, transparent 60%);
}
.banner-horaloca .banner-inner-glow {
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 0%, rgba(139,184,212,0.2) 0%, transparent 55%);
}

.banner-content {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}

.banner-tag {
  display: inline-block;
  font-size: 9px;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: 0.35em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: #A8D8EA;
  border: 1px solid rgba(168,216,234,0.4);
  padding: 4px 16px;
  border-radius: 1px;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
  text-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(126,203,230,0.6);
  box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(126,203,230,0.12);
}

.banner-title {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-style: italic;
  font-size: clamp(2rem, 6vw, 3.5rem);
  font-weight: 400;
  color: var(--pearl-bright);
  text-shadow: 0 2px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
  line-height: 1.1;
}

.banner-subtitle {
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 300;
  letter-spacing: 0.2em;
  color: var(--pearl-mid);
  margin-top: 0.6rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

/* ============================================================
   SECTION LAYOUT
============================================================ */
.section { display: none; animation: sectionIn 0.5s ease forwards; }
.section.active { display: block; }

@keyframes sectionIn {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(16px); }
  to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}

.section-body {
  max-width: 680px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 2rem 1.25rem 5rem;
}

/* ============================================================
   CARDS
============================================================ */
.card {
  background: linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(22,34,54,0.85) 0%, rgba(18,32,52,0.9) 100%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(200,212,220,0.12);
  border-radius: 3px;
  padding: 1.5rem;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  transition: border-color 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s;
}

.card:hover { border-color: rgba(126,203,230,0.4); box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(126,203,230,0.08); }

.card-title {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-style: italic;
  font-size: 1.15rem;
  color: var(--pearl-bright);
  margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.6rem;
}

.step-badge {
  width: 24px; height: 24px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--navy-soft), var(--navy-light));
  border: 1px solid rgba(139,184,212,0.3);
  color: var(--accent);
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 500;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  font-style: normal;
}

/* ============================================================
   FORM FIELDS
============================================================ */
.field { margin-bottom: 1rem; }

.field label {
  display: block;
  font-size: 9px;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: 0.2em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--pearl-mid);
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}

.field input,
.field textarea,
.field select {
  width: 100%;
  padding: 0.6rem 0.85rem;
  background: rgba(13,27,42,0.6);
  border: 1px solid rgba(200,212,220,0.15);
  border-radius: 2px;
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 300;
  color: var(--pearl);
  outline: none;
  transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
}

.field input:focus,
.field textarea:focus {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(139,184,212,0.1);
}

.field input::placeholder,
.field textarea::placeholder { color: rgba(200,212,220,0.3); }

.field textarea { resize: vertical; min-height: 80px; }

/* ============================================================
   DROP ZONE
============================================================ */
.drop-zone {
  border: 1px dashed rgba(200,212,220,0.25);
  border-radius: 3px;
  padding: 2.5rem 1rem;
  text-align: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.25s;
  background: rgba(13,27,42,0.4);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.drop-zone::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 0%, rgba(139,184,212,0.06) 0%, transparent 60%);
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.3s;
}

.drop-zone:hover { border-color: var(--accent); }
.drop-zone:hover::before { opacity: 1; }
.drop-zone.dragover { border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(139,184,212,0.15); }

.drop-icon { font-size: 2.8rem; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; }
.drop-title { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 300; color: var(--pearl); margin-bottom: 0.3rem; }
.drop-sub { font-size: 11px; color: var(--pearl-mid); font-weight: 300; }

input[type="file"] { display: none; }

/* ============================================================
   PREVIEW GRID
============================================================ */
.preview-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 6px;
  margin-top: 0.75rem;
}

.preview-item {
  aspect-ratio: 1;
  border-radius: 2px;
  overflow: hidden;
  position: relative;
  border: 1px solid rgba(200,212,220,0.1);
  animation: fadeIn 0.35s ease;
}

.preview-item img { width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; }

.preview-item .remove {
  position: absolute; top: 3px; right: 3px;
  width: 18px; height: 18px;
  background: rgba(13,27,42,0.85);
  color: var(--pearl);
  border: none;
  border-radius: 50%;
  font-size: 10px;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.15s;
}

.preview-item:hover .remove { opacity: 1; }

/* ============================================================
   PROGRESS BAR
============================================================ */
.progress-wrap {
  margin-top: 0.75rem;
  display: none;
}

.progress-track {
  height: 2px;
  background: rgba(200,212,220,0.1);
  border-radius: 2px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.progress-fill {
  height: 100%;
  width: 0%;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--navy-soft), var(--accent), var(--silver));
  border-radius: 2px;
  transition: width 0.4s ease;
  box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--accent);
}

/* ============================================================
   BUTTONS
============================================================ */
/* Primary CTA — glow effect */
.btn-cta {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  padding: 1rem;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--navy-soft) 0%, var(--navy-light) 100%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(139,184,212,0.3);
  color: var(--pearl-bright);
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: 0.2em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  cursor: pointer;
  border-radius: 50px;
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: all 0.3s;
  margin-top: 0.5rem;
}

.btn-cta::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0; left: -100%;
  width: 100%; height: 100%;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(139,184,212,0.15), transparent);
  transition: left 0.5s ease;
}

.btn-cta:hover { border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(139,184,212,0.2); }
.btn-cta:hover::before { left: 100%; }
.btn-cta:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }

/* AI button */
.btn-ai {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  padding: 0.8rem;
  background: transparent;
  border: 1px solid rgba(200,212,220,0.2);
  color: var(--silver);
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 400;
  letter-spacing: 0.18em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  cursor: pointer;
  border-radius: 50px;
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: all 0.3s;
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

.btn-ai::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 50%, rgba(139,184,212,0.08) 0%, transparent 70%);
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.3s;
}

.btn-ai:hover { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent); }
.btn-ai:hover::after { opacity: 1; }
.btn-ai:disabled { opacity: 0.35; cursor: not-allowed; }

/* AI badge */
.ai-badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  font-size: 9px;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: 0.15em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--accent);
  border: 1px solid rgba(139,184,212,0.25);
  padding: 4px 12px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  margin-bottom: 0.85rem;
}

.ai-badge-dot {
  width: 5px; height: 5px;
  background: var(--accent);
  border-radius: 50%;
  animation: pulse 2s ease infinite;
}

/* ============================================================
   GALLERY
============================================================ */
.stats-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 0.75rem;
  margin-bottom: 1.75rem;
}

.stat-card {
  background: linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(22,34,54,0.85), rgba(30,48,80,0.8));
  border: 1px solid rgba(200,212,220,0.15);
  border-radius: 3px;
  padding: 1.25rem 0.75rem;
  text-align: center;
  transition: box-shadow 0.3s, border-color 0.3s;
}
.stat-card:hover { border-color: rgba(126,203,230,0.4); box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(126,203,230,0.12); }

.stat-num {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 2.2rem;
  font-weight: 400;
  color: #0D1B2A;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: #0D1B2A;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1;
  margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
}

.stat-label {
  font-size: 9px;
  letter-spacing: 0.2em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--pearl-mid);
  font-weight: 400;
}

.gallery-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(160px, 1fr));
  gap: 8px;
}

.gallery-item {
  aspect-ratio: 4/3;
  border-radius: 2px;
  overflow: hidden;
  position: relative;
  cursor: pointer;
  border: 1px solid rgba(200,212,220,0.07);
  animation: fadeIn 0.4s ease;
}

.gallery-item img { width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; transition: transform 0.35s ease; }
.gallery-item:hover img { transform: scale(1.06); }

.gallery-overlay {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(transparent 40%, rgba(13,27,42,0.75));
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.25s;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  padding: 0.6rem;
}

.gallery-item:hover .gallery-overlay { opacity: 1; }
.gallery-guest { font-size: 11px; color: var(--pearl); font-weight: 400; }
.gallery-msg { font-size: 10px; color: var(--silver); font-style: italic; margin-top: 2px; }

/* Moment tag on gallery items */
.moment-tag {
  position: absolute;
  top: 6px; left: 6px;
  font-size: 8px;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 2px 8px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
}

.mt-ceremonia { background: rgba(139,184,212,0.25); color: var(--silver-glow); border: 1px solid rgba(139,184,212,0.3); }
.mt-recepcion { background: rgba(201,185,154,0.2); color: #d4c4a8; border: 1px solid rgba(201,185,154,0.3); }
.mt-horaloca  { background: rgba(100,150,200,0.25); color: var(--accent); border: 1px solid rgba(100,150,200,0.3); }

.gallery-empty {
  grid-column: 1/-1;
  text-align: center;
  padding: 4rem 1rem;
  color: rgba(200,212,220,0.35);
}

.gallery-empty .big-icon { font-size: 3rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; display: block; }
.gallery-empty p { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 300; }

/* ============================================================
   LIVE WALL
============================================================ */
.live-wrap {
  min-height: calc(100vh - 52px);
  background: var(--navy);
  padding: 2rem 1.25rem;
}

.live-header {
  text-align: center;
  margin-bottom: 2rem;
}

.live-indicator {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 400;
  letter-spacing: 0.25em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: #7ECBE6;
  text-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(126,203,230,0.5);
  margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
}

.live-dot-anim {
  width: 8px; height: 8px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #4ade80;
  animation: livePulse 1.4s ease-in-out infinite;
}

@keyframes livePulse {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(74,222,128,0.4); }
  50% { opacity: 0.7; transform: scale(0.85); box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px rgba(74,222,128,0); }
}

.live-title {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-style: italic;
  font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 2.2rem);
  color: var(--pearl);
  font-weight: 400;
}

.live-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(200px, 1fr));
  gap: 8px;
}

.live-photo {
  aspect-ratio: 4/3;
  border-radius: 2px;
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid rgba(200,212,220,0.08);
  animation: liveIn 0.6s ease;
}

@keyframes liveIn {
  from { opacity:0; transform: scale(0.95) translateY(10px); }
  to   { opacity:1; transform: scale(1) translateY(0); }
}

.live-photo img { width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; }

/* ============================================================
   DJ
============================================================ */
.song-list { margin-top: 1.25rem; }

.song-item {
  background: rgba(22,34,54,0.6);
  border: 1px solid rgba(200,212,220,0.08);
  border-radius: 2px;
  padding: 0.85rem 1rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  transition: border-color 0.2s;
  animation: fadeIn 0.3s ease;
}

.song-item:hover { border-color: rgba(139,184,212,0.2); }

.song-rank {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.4rem;
  color: rgba(200,212,220,0.2);
  font-weight: 400;
  min-width: 28px;
  text-align: center;
}

.song-info { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }

.song-title {
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 400;
  color: var(--pearl);
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.song-by {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--pearl-mid);
  margin-top: 2px;
  font-weight: 300;
}

.song-votes {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.vote-btn {
  background: transparent;
  border: 1px solid rgba(126,203,230,0.35);
  color: #7ECBE6;
  padding: 4px 10px;
  border-radius: 50px;
  font-size: 11px;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  transition: all 0.25s;
}

.vote-btn:hover { background: rgba(126,203,230,0.15); border-color: #7ECBE6; box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(126,203,230,0.3); }

.vote-count {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  color: var(--pearl-mid);
  min-width: 22px;
  text-align: center;
}

/* ============================================================
   GUESTBOOK
============================================================ */
.messages-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  margin-top: 1.25rem;
}

@media (max-width: 520px) { .messages-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }

.msg-card {
  background: linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(22,34,54,0.85), rgba(18,32,52,0.9));
  border: 1px solid rgba(200,212,220,0.1);
  border-radius: 3px;
  padding: 1.25rem;
  animation: fadeIn 0.4s ease;
  transition: border-color 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s;
}

.msg-card:hover { border-color: rgba(168,216,234,0.35); box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(126,203,230,0.1); }

.msg-emoji { font-size: 1.5rem; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; }

.msg-text {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-style: italic;
  font-size: 1rem;
  color: var(--pearl-bright);
  line-height: 1.55;
  margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
}

.msg-author {
  font-size: 9px;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: 0.2em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--accent);
}

/* ============================================================
   QR SECTION
============================================================ */
.qr-center {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 1.25rem;
}

.qr-box {
  background: var(--pearl-warm);
  border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 1.75rem;
  text-align: center;
  border: 1px solid rgba(200,212,220,0.2);
}

#qrcode canvas { border-radius: 2px; }

.qr-caption {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-style: italic;
  font-size: 1rem;
  color: var(--navy);
  margin-top: 0.85rem;
}

.qr-url {
  font-size: 10px;
  color: var(--navy-soft);
  margin-top: 0.3rem;
  font-family: monospace;
  word-break: break-all;
}

/* ============================================================
   LIGHTBOX
============================================================ */
.lightbox {
  display: none;
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  background: rgba(13,27,42,0.95);
  z-index: 500;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 1rem;
}

.lightbox.open { display: flex; }
.lightbox img { max-width: 90vw; max-height: 87vh; object-fit: contain; border-radius: 2px; }

.lb-close {
  position: absolute;
  top: 1rem; right: 1rem;
  background: transparent;
  border: 1px solid rgba(200,212,220,0.3);
  color: var(--pearl-mid);
  width: 36px; height: 36px;
  border-radius: 50px;
  font-size: 16px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.2s;
}

.lb-close:hover { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent); }

/* ============================================================
   MOBILE NAV
============================================================ */
.mobile-nav {
  display: none;
  position: fixed;
  bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
  background: rgba(13,27,42,0.96);
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(200,212,220,0.1);
  backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
  z-index: 200;
  padding: 0.4rem 0 0.6rem;
}

.mobile-nav-row {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-around;
}

.mn-btn {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 3px;
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  color: rgba(200,212,220,0.4);
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 8px;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  cursor: pointer;
  padding: 6px 8px;
  transition: color 0.15s;
}

.mn-btn.active { color: #7ECBE6; text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(126,203,230,0.6); }
.mn-btn .mn-icon { font-size: 1.3rem; }

@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .mobile-nav { display: block; }
  .nav-links { display: none; }
  body { padding-bottom: 68px; }
}

/* ============================================================
   TOAST
============================================================ */
.toast {
  position: fixed;
  bottom: 5rem; left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(20px);
  background: rgba(22,34,54,0.95);
  color: var(--pearl);
  border: 1px solid rgba(139,184,212,0.25);
  padding: 0.7rem 1.4rem;
  border-radius: 12px;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 300;
  z-index: 999;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: all 0.3s;
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  white-space: nowrap;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
}

.toast.show { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0); }

/* ============================================================
   CONFIG NOTICE
============================================================ */
.config-notice {
  background: rgba(139,184,212,0.07);
  border: 1px solid rgba(139,184,212,0.2);
  border-radius: 3px;
  padding: 1rem 1.25rem;
  margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 300;
  color: var(--silver);
  line-height: 1.7;
}

.config-notice strong { color: var(--accent); font-weight: 500; }

/* Divider */
.section-divider {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  margin: 1.5rem 0;
  opacity: 0.4;
}

.section-divider::before,
.section-divider::after {
  content: '';
  flex: 1;
  height: 1px;
  background: var(--pearl-mid);
}

.section-divider span { font-size: 10px; white-space: nowrap; color: var(--pearl-mid); letter-spacing: 0.15em; }

/* Animations */
@keyframes fadeIn { from { opacity:0; } to { opacity:1; } }
@keyframes riseIn { from { opacity:0; transform:translateY(22px); } to { opacity:1; transform:translateY(0); } }
@keyframes pulse  { 0%,100% { opacity:1; } 50% { opacity:0.4; } }

/* Scroll indicator */
.scroll-hint {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 2rem;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  z-index: 4;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  opacity: 0;
  animation: riseIn 1s ease 2.5s forwards;
}

.scroll-hint span {
  font-size: 9px;
  letter-spacing: 0.25em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: rgba(13,27,42,0.85);
  font-weight: 700;
}

.scroll-arrow {
  width: 20px; height: 20px;
  border-right: 1px solid rgba(13,27,42,0.7);
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(13,27,42,0.7);
  transform: rotate(45deg);
  animation: scrollBounce 2s ease infinite;
}

@keyframes scrollBounce {
  0%,100% { transform: rotate(45deg) translateY(0); }
  50% { transform: rotate(45deg) translateY(5px); }
}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- Particles background -->
<canvas id="particles-canvas"></canvas>

<!-- ============================================================
  HERO
============================================================ -->
<div id="page-hero">
  <!-- Background (replaced by user photo) -->
  <div class="hero-bg has-photo" id="hero-bg">
    <img id="hero-bg-img" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Adriana y William" style="display:block;">
  </div>
  <div class="hero-shimmer"></div>

  <div class="hero-content">
    

    <h1 class="hero-names">
      Adriana María
      <span class="hero-amp">— <span style="color:#4A9FD4;text-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(74,159,212,0.8),0 0 60px rgba(74,159,212,0.4);">&</span> —</span>
      William Enrique
    </h1>

    <div class="deco-line"><div class="deco-diamond"></div></div>


    <!-- COUNTDOWN -->
    <div class="countdown-block">
      <p class="countdown-label">¡Apresúrate! Falta tan solo…</p>
      <div class="countdown-units">
        <div class="cd-unit">
          <div class="cd-num" id="cd-days">--</div>
          <div class="cd-lbl">Días</div>
        </div>
        <div class="cd-sep">·</div>
        <div class="cd-unit">
          <div class="cd-num" id="cd-hours">--</div>
          <div class="cd-lbl">Horas</div>
        </div>
        <div class="cd-sep">·</div>
        <div class="cd-unit">
          <div class="cd-num" id="cd-mins">--</div>
          <div class="cd-lbl">Minutos</div>
        </div>
        <div class="cd-sep">·</div>
        <div class="cd-unit">
          <div class="cd-num" id="cd-secs">--</div>
          <div class="cd-lbl">Segundos</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- MOMENT SELECTION -->
    <div class="hero-cta">
      <p style="color:#0D1B2A;letter-spacing:0.2em;font-size:12px;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:700;">Elige el momento y comparte tus fotos</p>
      <div class="moment-btns">
        <button class="btn-moment pulse" onclick="goMoment('ceremonia')">
          🕊 Ceremonia
        </button>
        <button class="btn-moment pulse" onclick="goMoment('recepcion')" style="animation-delay:0.4s">
          🥂 Recepción
        </button>
        <button class="btn-moment pulse" onclick="goMoment('horaloca')" style="animation-delay:0.8s">
          🎉 Hora Loca
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Upload hero photo -->
  <div class="hero-photo-upload">
    <button class="btn-upload-bg" onclick="document.getElementById('hero-photo-input').click()">
      📷 Cambiar foto de fondo
    </button>
    <input type="file" id="hero-photo-input" accept="image/*" onchange="setHeroBg(this)">
  </div>

  <div class="scroll-hint">
    <span>Explorar</span>
    <div class="scroll-arrow"></div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- NAV -->
<nav id="main-nav">
  <div class="nav-brand" onclick="showHero()">A & W</div>
  <ul class="nav-links">
    <li><a onclick="showHero()">Inicio</a></li>
    <li><a onclick="goMoment('ceremonia')" id="nav-c">Ceremonia</a></li>
    <li><a onclick="goMoment('recepcion')" id="nav-r">Recepción</a></li>
    <li><a onclick="goMoment('horaloca')" id="nav-h">Hora Loca</a></li>
    <li><a onclick="showSection('gallery')">Galería</a></li>
    <li><a onclick="showSection('live')">En Vivo</a></li>
    <li><a onclick="showSection('dj')">DJ</a></li>
    <li><a onclick="showSection('guestbook')">Libro</a></li>
    <li><a onclick="showSection('qr')">QR</a></li>
  </ul>
</nav>

<!-- ============================================================
  MOMENTO: CEREMONIA
============================================================ -->
<div id="ceremonia-section" class="section">
  <div class="moment-banner banner-ceremonia">
    <div class="banner-inner-glow"></div>
    <div class="banner-content">
      <div class="banner-tag">Momento 01 · Ceremonia</div>
      <h2 class="banner-title">La Ceremonia</h2>
      <p class="banner-subtitle">El instante en que dos corazones se unieron para siempre</p>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="section-body" id="ceremonia-body">
    <!-- Upload form injected by JS -->
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ============================================================
  MOMENTO: RECEPCIÓN
============================================================ -->
<div id="recepcion-section" class="section">
  <div class="moment-banner banner-recepcion">
    <div class="banner-inner-glow"></div>
    <div class="banner-content">
      <div class="banner-tag">Momento 02 · Recepción</div>
      <h2 class="banner-title">La Recepción</h2>
      <p class="banner-subtitle">Risas, brindis y memorias compartidas alrededor de la mesa</p>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="section-body" id="recepcion-body">
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ============================================================
  MOMENTO: HORA LOCA
============================================================ -->
<div id="horaloca-section" class="section">
  <div class="moment-banner banner-horaloca">
    <div class="banner-inner-glow"></div>
    <div class="banner-content">
      <div class="banner-tag">Momento 03 · Hora Loca</div>
      <h2 class="banner-title">Hora Loca</h2>
      <p class="banner-subtitle">El baile, la euforia y los recuerdos que no se olvidan jamás</p>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="section-body" id="horaloca-body">
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ============================================================
  GALERÍA GENERAL
============================================================ -->
<div id="gallery-section" class="section">
  <div class="moment-banner banner-ceremonia" style="padding: 2.5rem 1.5rem 2rem;">
    <div class="banner-inner-glow"></div>
    <div class="banner-content">
      <div class="banner-tag">Álbum completo</div>
      <h2 class="banner-title" style="font-size:clamp(1.8rem,5vw,2.8rem);">Galería de la Boda</h2>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="section-body">
    <div class="stats-row">
      <div class="stat-card"><div class="stat-num" id="stat-photos">0</div><div class="stat-label">Fotos</div></div>
      <div class="stat-card"><div class="stat-num" id="stat-guests">0</div><div class="stat-label">Invitados</div></div>
      <div class="stat-card"><div class="stat-num" id="stat-msgs">0</div><div class="stat-label">Mensajes</div></div>
    </div>
    <!-- Filtros por momento -->
    <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:1.25rem;">
      <button class="vote-btn" onclick="filterGallery('all')" id="gf-all" style="font-size:10px;letter-spacing:0.1em;">Todos</button>
      <button class="vote-btn" onclick="filterGallery('ceremonia')" id="gf-ceremonia" style="font-size:10px;letter-spacing:0.1em;">🕊 Ceremonia</button>
      <button class="vote-btn" onclick="filterGallery('recepcion')" id="gf-recepcion" style="font-size:10px;letter-spacing:0.1em;">🥂 Recepción</button>
      <button class="vote-btn" onclick="filterGallery('horaloca')" id="gf-horaloca" style="font-size:10px;letter-spacing:0.1em;">🎉 Hora Loca</button>
    </div>
    <div id="gallery-grid" class="gallery-grid"></div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ============================================================
  PANTALLA EN VIVO
============================================================ -->
<div id="live-section" class="section">
  <div class="live-wrap">
    <div class="live-header">
      <div class="live-indicator"><div class="live-dot-anim"></div>Transmisión en vivo</div>
      <div class="live-title">Adriana María & William Enrique</div>
    </div>
    <div id="live-grid" class="live-grid"></div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ============================================================
  DJ
============================================================ -->
<div id="dj-section" class="section">
  <div class="moment-banner banner-recepcion" style="padding:2.5rem 1.5rem 2rem;">
    <div class="banner-inner-glow"></div>
    <div class="banner-content">
      <div class="banner-tag">Para el DJ</div>
      <h2 class="banner-title" style="font-size:clamp(1.8rem,5vw,2.8rem);">Lista de Canciones</h2>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="section-body">
    <div class="card">
      <div class="card-title"><span class="step-badge">♪</span> Sugiere una canción</div>
      <div class="field"><label>Canción</label><input type="text" id="song-title" placeholder="Ej: La Bicicleta"></div>
      <div class="field"><label>Artista</label><input type="text" id="song-artist" placeholder="Ej: Carlos Vives"></div>
      <div class="field"><label>Tu nombre</label><input type="text" id="song-guest" placeholder="Ej: Juan Carlos"></div>
    </div>
    <button class="btn-cta" onclick="addSong()">Agregar canción a la lista 🎶</button>
    <div id="song-list" class="song-list"></div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ============================================================
  LIBRO DE VISITAS
============================================================ -->
<div id="guestbook-section" class="section">
  <div class="moment-banner banner-horaloca" style="padding:2.5rem 1.5rem 2rem;">
    <div class="banner-inner-glow"></div>
    <div class="banner-content">
      <div class="banner-tag">Libro de visitas</div>
      <h2 class="banner-title" style="font-size:clamp(1.8rem,5vw,2.8rem);">Tu Mensaje</h2>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="section-body">
    <div class="card">
      <div class="card-title"><span class="step-badge">✍</span> Escríbeles algo</div>
      <div class="field"><label>Tu nombre</label><input type="text" id="gb-name" placeholder="Carlos y Ana"></div>
      <div class="field">
        <label>Emoción del momento</label>
        <select id="gb-emoji">
          <option>💛</option><option>🥂</option><option>💍</option>
          <option>🌹</option><option>🎉</option><option>😍</option>
          <option>🙏</option><option>✨</option><option>💃</option><option>🎶</option>
        </select>
      </div>
      <div class="field"><label>Mensaje para los novios</label>
        <textarea id="gb-message" placeholder="Que su amor sea eterno y lleno de aventuras maravillosas…"></textarea>
      </div>
    </div>
    <button class="btn-cta" onclick="addMessage()">Dejar mi mensaje 💌</button>
    <div id="messages-grid" class="messages-grid"></div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ============================================================
  QR
============================================================ -->
<div id="qr-section" class="section">
  <div class="moment-banner banner-ceremonia" style="padding:2.5rem 1.5rem 2rem;">
    <div class="banner-inner-glow"></div>
    <div class="banner-content">
      <div class="banner-tag">Para invitados</div>
      <h2 class="banner-title" style="font-size:clamp(1.8rem,5vw,2.8rem);">Código QR</h2>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="section-body">
    <div class="qr-center">
      <div class="qr-box">
        <div id="qrcode"></div>
        <p class="qr-caption">Adriana María & William Enrique</p>
        <p class="qr-url" id="qr-url-txt"></p>
      </div>
      <div class="card" style="width:100%;">
        <div class="card-title"><span class="step-badge">📋</span> Instrucciones para imprimir</div>
        <p style="font-size:13px;color:var(--pearl-mid);line-height:1.8;font-weight:300;">
          1. Descarga la imagen del QR<br>
          2. Imprímela en tarjetas para cada mesa<br>
          3. Los invitados escanean con la cámara del celular<br>
          4. Sin descargar ninguna app — todo desde el navegador
        </p>
        <button class="btn-cta" style="margin-top:1rem;" onclick="downloadQR()">Descargar QR para imprimir</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- LIGHTBOX -->
<div class="lightbox" id="lightbox" onclick="closeLightbox()">
  <button class="lb-close" onclick="closeLightbox()">✕</button>
  <img id="lb-img" src="" alt="">
</div>

<!-- MOBILE NAV -->
<div class="mobile-nav">
  <div class="mobile-nav-row">
    <button class="mn-btn" onclick="goMoment('ceremonia')"><span class="mn-icon">🕊</span>Ceremonia</button>
    <button class="mn-btn" onclick="goMoment('recepcion')"><span class="mn-icon">🥂</span>Recepción</button>
    <button class="mn-btn" onclick="goMoment('horaloca')"><span class="mn-icon">🎉</span>Hora Loca</button>
    <button class="mn-btn" onclick="showSection('gallery')"><span class="mn-icon">🖼</span>Galería</button>
    <button class="mn-btn" onclick="showSection('guestbook')"><span class="mn-icon">✍</span>Libro</button>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- TOAST -->
<div class="toast" id="toast"></div>

<!-- ============================================================
  JAVASCRIPT
============================================================ -->
<script>
// ============================================================
// CONFIG — reemplaza con tus datos
// ============================================================
const CONFIG = {
  cloudinaryCloud:  'dvozeifss',
  cloudinaryPreset: 'boda_adriana_william',
  appUrl: window.location.href.split('?')[0],
  weddingDate: new Date('2026-11-15T02:00:00') // 2am del 15 nov 2026
};
// ============================================================

// State (persiste en localStorage)
let state = {
  photos:   JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('boda_photos')   || '[]'),
  songs:    JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('boda_songs')    || '[]'),
  messages: JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('boda_messages') || '[]'),
  selectedFiles: [],
  currentMoment: null,
  aiApplied: false,
  galleryFilter: 'all'
};

const momentLabels = {
  ceremonia: '🕊 Ceremonia',
  recepcion: '🥂 Recepción',
  horaloca:  '🎉 Hora Loca'
};

function save() {
  localStorage.setItem('boda_photos',   JSON.stringify(state.photos));
  localStorage.setItem('boda_songs',    JSON.stringify(state.songs));
  localStorage.setItem('boda_messages', JSON.stringify(state.messages));
}

// ============================================================
// NAVIGATION
// ============================================================
function showHero() {
  document.getElementById('page-hero').style.display = 'flex';
  document.getElementById('main-nav').style.display  = 'none';
  ['ceremonia','recepcion','horaloca','gallery','live','dj','guestbook','qr']
    .forEach(s => document.getElementById(s+'-section').classList.remove('active'));
  window.scrollTo(0,0);
}

function showSection(name) {
  document.getElementById('page-hero').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('main-nav').style.display  = 'flex';
  ['ceremonia','recepcion','horaloca','gallery','live','dj','guestbook','qr']
    .forEach(s => document.getElementById(s+'-section').classList.remove('active'));
  const el = document.getElementById(name+'-section');
  if (el) { el.classList.add('active'); }
  if (name === 'gallery')   { renderGallery(); }
  if (name === 'live')      { renderLive(); }
  if (name === 'dj')        { renderSongs(); }
  if (name === 'guestbook') { renderMessages(); }
  if (name === 'qr')        { generateQR(); }
  window.scrollTo(0,0);
}

function goMoment(moment) {
  state.currentMoment = moment;
  buildUploadForm(moment);
  showSection(moment);
}

// ============================================================
// BUILD UPLOAD FORM (dynamic per moment)
// ============================================================
function buildUploadForm(moment) {
  const icons = { ceremonia:'🕊', recepcion:'🥂', horaloca:'🎉' };
  const body = document.getElementById(moment+'-body');
  body.innerHTML = `
    <div class="config-notice" id="cfg-warn" style="${CONFIG.cloudinaryCloud === 'TU_CLOUD_NAME' ? '' : 'display:none'}">
      ⚠️ <strong>Configuración pendiente:</strong> Ingresa tu Cloud Name y Upload Preset de Cloudinary para activar la subida real. Las fotos se guardan localmente mientras tanto.
    </div>

    <div class="card">
      <div class="card-title"><span class="step-badge">1</span> Tus datos</div>
      <div class="field"><label>Tu nombre completo</label>
        <input type="text" id="guest-name-${moment}" placeholder="María García"></div>
      <div class="field"><label>Correo (opcional)</label>
        <input type="email" id="guest-email-${moment}" placeholder="maria@correo.com"></div>
    </div>

    <div class="card">
      <div class="card-title"><span class="step-badge">2</span> Selecciona tus fotos</div>
      <div class="ai-badge"><div class="ai-badge-dot"></div> IA activa — mejora automática al subir</div>
      <div class="drop-zone" id="dz-${moment}"
           onclick="document.getElementById('fi-${moment}').click()"
           ondragover="dzOver(event,'${moment}')"
           ondragleave="dzLeave('${moment}')"
           ondrop="dzDrop(event,'${moment}')">
        <div class="drop-icon">${icons[moment]}</div>
        <p class="drop-title">Toca aquí o arrastra tus fotos</p>
        <p class="drop-sub">Sin límite de fotos ni tamaño · JPG PNG HEIC</p>
      </div>
      <input type="file" id="fi-${moment}" multiple accept="image/*"
             onchange="handleFiles(this.files,'${moment}')">
      <div id="pg-${moment}" class="preview-grid"></div>
      <div class="progress-wrap" id="pw-${moment}">
        <div class="progress-track"><div class="progress-fill" id="pf-${moment}"></div></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="card">
      <div class="card-title"><span class="step-badge">3</span> Mejora con Inteligencia Artificial</div>
      <button class="btn-ai" id="ai-btn-${moment}" onclick="applyAI('${moment}')" disabled>
        ✨ Aplicar mejoras con IA — brillo, nitidez y color
      </button>
      <p style="font-size:10px;color:var(--pearl-mid);text-align:center;font-weight:300;">
        Powered by Cloudinary AI · Incluido gratis
      </p>
    </div>

    <div class="card">
      <div class="card-title"><span class="step-badge">4</span> Tu mensaje</div>
      <div class="field"><label>Mensaje para los novios (opcional)</label>
        <textarea id="gm-${moment}" placeholder="¡Fue un momento mágico! Los queremos mucho…"></textarea>
      </div>
    </div>

    <button class="btn-cta" id="upload-btn-${moment}" onclick="uploadPhotos('${moment}')">
      Compartir mis fotos — ${momentLabels[moment]}
    </button>

    <div style="margin-top:1.5rem;text-align:center;">
      <button style="background:transparent;border:none;color:var(--pearl-mid);font-family:var(--font-body);font-size:11px;font-weight:300;letter-spacing:0.12em;cursor:pointer;text-transform:uppercase;" onclick="showSection('gallery')">
        Ver galería completa →
      </button>
    </div>
  `;
  // Reset per-moment file arrays
  state[moment+'_files'] = [];
}

// ============================================================
// DRAG & DROP
// ============================================================
function dzOver(e, m) { e.preventDefault(); document.getElementById('dz-'+m).classList.add('dragover'); }
function dzLeave(m)   { document.getElementById('dz-'+m).classList.remove('dragover'); }
function dzDrop(e, m) {
  e.preventDefault();
  document.getElementById('dz-'+m).classList.remove('dragover');
  handleFiles(e.dataTransfer.files, m);
}

// ============================================================
// FILE HANDLING
// ============================================================
function handleFiles(files, moment) {
  if (!state[moment+'_files']) state[moment+'_files'] = [];
  Array.from(files).forEach(f => {
    if (!f.type.startsWith('image/')) return;
    state[moment+'_files'].push(f);
    const idx = state[moment+'_files'].length - 1;
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = e => addPreview(e.target.result, idx, moment);
    reader.readAsDataURL(f);
  });
  const btn = document.getElementById('ai-btn-'+moment);
  if (btn) btn.disabled = (state[moment+'_files'] || []).filter(Boolean).length === 0;
}

function addPreview(src, idx, moment) {
  const grid = document.getElementById('pg-'+moment);
  if (!grid) return;
  const div = document.createElement('div');
  div.className = 'preview-item';
  div.id = 'prev-'+moment+'-'+idx;
  div.innerHTML = `<img src="${src}" alt="preview"><button class="remove" onclick="removeFile(${idx},'${moment}')">✕</button>`;
  grid.appendChild(div);
}

function removeFile(idx, moment) {
  if (state[moment+'_files']) state[moment+'_files'][idx] = null;
  const el = document.getElementById('prev-'+moment+'-'+idx);
  if (el) el.remove();
}

// ============================================================
// AI
// ============================================================
function applyAI(moment) {
  const btn = document.getElementById('ai-btn-'+moment);
  btn.disabled = true;
  btn.textContent = '✨ Aplicando mejoras…';
  setTimeout(() => {
    btn.textContent = '✅ IA aplicada — fotos mejoradas';
    state.aiApplied = true;
    showToast('Mejoras de IA aplicadas ✨');
  }, 2000);
}

// ============================================================
// UPLOAD
// ============================================================
async function uploadPhotos(moment) {
  const name = (document.getElementById('guest-name-'+moment)||{}).value?.trim();
  const files = (state[moment+'_files']||[]).filter(Boolean);
  if (!name) { showToast('Escribe tu nombre para continuar'); return; }
  if (!files.length) { showToast('Selecciona al menos una foto'); return; }

  const btn = document.getElementById('upload-btn-'+moment);
  btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = 'Subiendo…';

  const pw = document.getElementById('pw-'+moment);
  const pf = document.getElementById('pf-'+moment);
  if (pw) pw.style.display = 'block';

  const message = (document.getElementById('gm-'+moment)||{}).value?.trim() || '';
  const isConfigured = CONFIG.cloudinaryCloud !== 'TU_CLOUD_NAME';

  for (let i = 0; i < files.length; i++) {
    const f = files[i];
    if (pf) pf.style.width = ((i/files.length)*90)+'%';

    let photoUrl = '';
    if (isConfigured) {
      try {
        const form = new FormData();
        form.append('file', f);
        form.append('upload_preset', CONFIG.cloudinaryPreset);
        form.append('folder', 'boda-adriana-william/'+moment);
        const res = await fetch(`https://api.cloudinary.com/v1_1/${CONFIG.cloudinaryCloud}/image/upload`, { method:'POST', body:form });
        const data = await res.json();
        photoUrl = state.aiApplied
          ? data.secure_url.replace('/upload/','/upload/e_improve,e_sharpen,e_auto_brightness/')
          : data.secure_url;
      } catch(err) { photoUrl = await toDataURL(f); }
    } else {
      photoUrl = await toDataURL(f);
    }

    state.photos.unshift({ url:photoUrl, name, message, moment, ai:state.aiApplied, time:new Date().toISOString() });
  }

  if (pf) pf.style.width = '100%';
  save();

  setTimeout(() => {
    if (pw) pw.style.display = 'none';
    if (pf) pf.style.width = '0%';
    state[moment+'_files'] = [];
    state.aiApplied = false;
    showToast(`¡Gracias ${name}! Fotos compartidas ${momentLabels[moment]}`);
    buildUploadForm(moment); // reset form
  }, 600);
}

function toDataURL(file) {
  return new Promise(res => { const r = new FileReader(); r.onload=e=>res(e.target.result); r.readAsDataURL(file); });
}

// ============================================================
// GALLERY
// ============================================================
function filterGallery(f) {
  state.galleryFilter = f;
  ['all','ceremonia','recepcion','horaloca'].forEach(k => {
    const btn = document.getElementById('gf-'+k);
    if (btn) btn.style.background = k===f ? 'rgba(139,184,212,0.2)' : 'transparent';
  });
  renderGallery();
}

function renderGallery() {
  const grid = document.getElementById('gallery-grid');
  const photos = state.galleryFilter === 'all'
    ? state.photos
    : state.photos.filter(p => p.moment === state.galleryFilter);

  const guests = [...new Set(state.photos.map(p=>p.name))];
  const withMsg = state.photos.filter(p=>p.message).length;
  document.getElementById('stat-photos').textContent = state.photos.length;
  document.getElementById('stat-guests').textContent = guests.length;
  document.getElementById('stat-msgs').textContent   = withMsg;

  if (!photos.length) {
    grid.innerHTML = `<div class="gallery-empty"><span class="big-icon">🖼</span><p>Aún no hay fotos en este momento.</p></div>`;
    return;
  }

  grid.innerHTML = photos.map((p,i) => `
    <div class="gallery-item" onclick="openLightbox('${p.url}')">
      <img src="${p.url}" alt="foto" loading="lazy">
      <div class="moment-tag mt-${p.moment||'ceremonia'}">${momentLabels[p.moment]||'Boda'}</div>
      <div class="gallery-overlay">
        <div class="gallery-guest">${p.name}${p.ai?' ✨':''}</div>
        ${p.message?`<div class="gallery-msg">"${p.message}"</div>`:''}
      </div>
    </div>
  `).join('');
}

// ============================================================
// LIVE
// ============================================================
function renderLive() {
  const grid = document.getElementById('live-grid');
  if (!state.photos.length) {
    grid.innerHTML = `<div class="gallery-empty" style="grid-column:1/-1;color:rgba(200,212,220,0.3);"><span class="big-icon">📡</span><p>Las fotos aparecerán aquí en tiempo real</p></div>`;
    return;
  }
  grid.innerHTML = state.photos.map(p => `
    <div class="live-photo"><img src="${p.url}" alt="foto" loading="lazy"></div>
  `).join('');
}

// ============================================================
// DJ
// ============================================================
function addSong() {
  const title  = document.getElementById('song-title').value.trim();
  const artist = document.getElementById('song-artist').value.trim();
  const guest  = document.getElementById('song-guest').value.trim();
  if (!title||!guest) { showToast('Escribe la canción y tu nombre'); return; }
  state.songs.unshift({ title, artist, guest, votes:0, id:Date.now() });
  save(); renderSongs();
  document.getElementById('song-title').value = '';
  document.getElementById('song-artist').value = '';
  document.getElementById('song-guest').value = '';
  showToast('¡Canción agregada! 🎶');
}

function voteSong(id) {
  const s = state.songs.find(s=>s.id===id);
  if (s) { s.votes++; save(); renderSongs(); }
}

function renderSongs() {
  const list = document.getElementById('song-list');
  if (!state.songs.length) {
    list.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:var(--pearl-mid);font-size:13px;margin-top:1rem;font-weight:300;">Aún no hay canciones sugeridas.</p>';
    return;
  }
  const sorted = [...state.songs].sort((a,b)=>b.votes-a.votes);
  list.innerHTML = sorted.map((s,i) => `
    <div class="song-item">
      <div class="song-rank">${i+1}</div>
      <div class="song-info">
        <div class="song-title">🎵 ${s.title}</div>
        <div class="song-by">${s.artist?s.artist+' · ':''}Por ${s.guest}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="song-votes">
        <button class="vote-btn" onclick="voteSong(${s.id})">👍</button>
        <span class="vote-count">${s.votes}</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  `).join('');
}

// ============================================================
// GUESTBOOK
// ============================================================
function addMessage() {
  const name  = document.getElementById('gb-name').value.trim();
  const msg   = document.getElementById('gb-message').value.trim();
  const emoji = document.getElementById('gb-emoji').value;
  if (!name||!msg) { showToast('Escribe tu nombre y mensaje'); return; }
  state.messages.unshift({ name, message:msg, emoji, time:new Date().toISOString() });
  save(); renderMessages();
  document.getElementById('gb-name').value = '';
  document.getElementById('gb-message').value = '';
  showToast('¡Mensaje guardado! 💌');
}

function renderMessages() {
  const grid = document.getElementById('messages-grid');
  if (!state.messages.length) {
    grid.innerHTML = '<div style="grid-column:1/-1;text-align:center;color:var(--pearl-mid);font-size:13px;padding:2rem;font-weight:300;">Los mensajes aparecerán aquí.</div>';
    return;
  }
  grid.innerHTML = state.messages.map(m => `
    <div class="msg-card">
      <div class="msg-emoji">${m.emoji}</div>
      <div class="msg-text">"${m.message}"</div>
      <div class="msg-author">— ${m.name}</div>
    </div>
  `).join('');
}

// ============================================================
// QR
// ============================================================
function generateQR() {
  const c = document.getElementById('qrcode');
  c.innerHTML = '';
  const url = CONFIG.appUrl;
  document.getElementById('qr-url-txt').textContent = url;
  new QRCode(c, { text:url, width:220, height:220,
    colorDark:'#0D1B2A', colorLight:'#F5F0E8',
    correctLevel: QRCode.CorrectLevel.H });
}

function downloadQR() {
  const canvas = document.querySelector('#qrcode canvas');
  if (!canvas) { showToast('El QR aún no está listo'); return; }
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.download = 'QR-Boda-Adriana-William.png';
  a.href = canvas.toDataURL();
  a.click();
  showToast('QR descargado 💛');
}

// ============================================================
// LIGHTBOX
// ============================================================
function openLightbox(src) {
  document.getElementById('lb-img').src = src;
  document.getElementById('lightbox').classList.add('open');
}
function closeLightbox() { document.getElementById('lightbox').classList.remove('open'); }

// ============================================================
// HERO BG PHOTO
// ============================================================
function setHeroBg(input) {
  const file = input.files[0];
  if (!file) return;
  const reader = new FileReader();
  reader.onload = e => {
    const img = document.getElementById('hero-bg-img');
    img.src = e.target.result;
    img.style.display = 'block';
    document.getElementById('hero-bg').classList.add('has-photo');
    showToast('Foto de fondo actualizada ✨');
  };
  reader.readAsDataURL(file);
}

// ============================================================
// COUNTDOWN
// ============================================================
function updateCountdown() {
  const now  = new Date();
  const diff = CONFIG.weddingDate - now;

  if (diff <= 0) {
    document.getElementById('cd-days').textContent  = '00';
    document.getElementById('cd-hours').textContent = '00';
    document.getElementById('cd-mins').textContent  = '00';
    document.getElementById('cd-secs').textContent  = '00';
    return;
  }

  const days  = Math.floor(diff / 86400000);
  const hours = Math.floor((diff % 86400000) / 3600000);
  const mins  = Math.floor((diff % 3600000)  / 60000);
  const secs  = Math.floor((diff % 60000)    / 1000);

  document.getElementById('cd-days').textContent  = String(days).padStart(2,'0');
  document.getElementById('cd-hours').textContent = String(hours).padStart(2,'0');
  document.getElementById('cd-mins').textContent  = String(mins).padStart(2,'0');
  document.getElementById('cd-secs').textContent  = String(secs).padStart(2,'0');
}

setInterval(updateCountdown, 1000);
updateCountdown();

// ============================================================
// TOAST
// ============================================================
function showToast(msg) {
  const t = document.getElementById('toast');
  t.textContent = msg;
  t.classList.add('show');
  setTimeout(() => t.classList.remove('show'), 3200);
}

// ============================================================
// PARTICLES
// ============================================================
(function() {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('particles-canvas');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  let W = window.innerWidth, H = window.innerHeight;
  canvas.width = W; canvas.height = H;

  window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
    W = canvas.width  = window.innerWidth;
    H = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
  });

  const PARTICLES = 55;
  const particles = Array.from({ length: PARTICLES }, () => ({
    x: Math.random() * W,
    y: Math.random() * H,
    r: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.3,
    vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.25,
    vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.25,
    alpha: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.1
  }));

  function draw() {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
    particles.forEach(p => {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(200,212,220,${p.alpha})`;
      ctx.fill();
      p.x += p.vx; p.y += p.vy;
      if (p.x < 0) p.x = W;
      if (p.x > W) p.x = 0;
      if (p.y < 0) p.y = H;
      if (p.y > H) p.y = 0;
    });
    requestAnimationFrame(draw);
  }

  draw();
})();

// Init
showHero();
</script>
</body>
</html>
